description: Soft-delete a reusable FUNCTION in the connected product. NOT for test cases: if the user asks to delete a TC or TC_* id, use `tc_delete` instead. Trigger words for THIS tool: "function", "FN_", "reusable function". TWO-STEP CONFIRM: call once with just `id` to preview the target (name + step count) and get a warning; then call again with `{ id, confirm: true }` to actually delete. Refuses to delete without `confirm:true`. `id` accepts the function's numeric id or business key. The backend refuses to delete a function that is still referenced by a test case, another function, or a workflow — this tool surfaces those references so the user can remove them first.

confirm.description: Set to true on the SECOND call to actually delete.

id.description: The function id (or business key like FN_123) to delete.

name: delete_function
title: Delete a reusable function (NOT a test case; two-step confirm)
